subject: AWS channel dealflow — private offer acceptance & invoice path
messages:
From: Amy Chen <amy@cloudops-resell.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: AWS Partner Manager <pm_aws@amazon.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AWS private offer — acceptance + invoice routing

Hi Olga / Sergio,

Thanks again for working with us on the AWS private offer for CloudOps. We received the private offer link from AWS and are ready to accept on our side — two quick operational questions before we proceed: 

1) Where should we route the reseller PO/invoice once the CPPO is accepted? Our finance team expects an email for invoices (and occasionally prefers a small PDF stub). 
2) Do you need a signed reseller agreement or any additional countersignature before the private offer can be finalized?

I've attached the PO draft for reference (CloudOps_PO_7894.pdf). We can sign DocuSign or return a scanned PDF — whichever you prefer. We are trying to close acceptance today if possible.

Thanks,
Amy Chen
Director, Channel Sales
CloudOps Reseller
[Attachment: CloudOps_PO_7894.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Amy Chen <amy@cloudops-resell.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS private offer — acceptance + invoice routing

Amy — great to hear. Short answer: we can accept once we have a signed PO and a billing instruction for the buyer. Details below and next steps:

- Invoice routing: please send final invoices to billing@cloudops-resell.com and cc accounting@redwood.com. Our finance team will also accept vendor invoices via AP portal (instructions attached).
- Reseller agreement: we have a standard reseller rev-share schedule that we countersign in DocuSign. For CPPO activation we need a signed PO (your preferred buyer contact on the PO) + the reseller signature on the rev-share schedule.
- DocuSign: I'll initiate a DocuSign envelope for the RevShare schedule to streamline countersign. If you prefer to send your signed PDF, we can accept that as long as it explicitly references deal RBW-CPPO-2027-1482.

Attached: Redwood_Billing_Instructions.pdf and a copy of the RevShare schedule we typically use (I will also start DocuSign). Please confirm the buyer contact name and whether the PO will be sent from CloudOps Billing or the buyer's parent company.

Expected timeline: if we get signed PO + rev-share countersigned today we can confirm acceptance with AWS by end of day and kick off marketplace SKU mapping.

Olga Petrov
Head of Partner Ops, Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.com
[Attachment: Redwood_Billing_Instructions.pdf]

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS private offer — acceptance + invoice routing

Adding a few technical/marketplace asks from our side: 

- SKU mapping: AWS requires we map the CPPO line items to our marketplace SKUs. Karthik, can you confirm the SKU list for the variant the reseller is purchasing?
- Entitlement window: For billing reconciliation, please confirm whether CloudOps wants monthly invoicing or a single upfront invoice. Monthly invoicing typically requires a subscription mapping in AWS Marketplace (we'll coordinate with the Partner Manager).
- Go-live onboarding: Tessa will take point on the CPPO activation and any test purchases to verify entitlements. Tessa, please prepare a 30-min checklist session with CloudOps once the CPPO is accepted.

Amy — once we have the PO and the signed rev-share schedule, I will push the acceptance through AWS CPPO flow and share the activation confirmation.

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Head of Channel Programs
Redwood Inference

From: Amy Chen <amy@cloudops-resell.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, CloudOps Billing <billing@cloudops-resell.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 08:09:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS private offer — acceptance + invoice routing

Thanks Olga / Sergio — attached is the countersigned PO and the buyer contact: Marcus Holt, procurement@cloudops-parent.com.

- PO attached: CloudOps_PO_7894_signed.pdf (our CFO signed)
- Invoice preference: send invoice to billing@cloudops-resell.com; Marcus will be cc'd on vendor communications. We prefer monthly invoicing aligned to usage, but for the first month we can accept an upfront pro-rata if easier for activation.
- DocuSign: I completed the DocuSign signature for the PO; please share the RevShare DocuSign when you have it.

Amy Chen
Director, Channel Sales
CloudOps Reseller
[Attachment: CloudOps_PO_7894_signed.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Amy Chen <amy@cloudops-resell.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Finance <accounting@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS private offer — acceptance + invoice routing

Amy — received, thank you. Next steps (I've done the actions in bold):

1) I have uploaded your signed PO to the HubSpot deal and attached it to RBW-CPPO-2027-1482. (link: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/52345/rbw-cppo-1482)
2) DocuSign: I created a DocuSign envelope for the Redwood Reseller RevShare schedule — you should receive a signing request shortly. Once countersigned I will countersign the envelope.
3) AWS CPPO acceptance: Pending the countersigned RevShare schedule, I will submit the CPPO acceptance with AWS and request SKU mapping. Expect confirmation from AWS Partner Manager within 24 hours after acceptance.
4) Invoicing: Redwood finance will send invoices monthly to billing@cloudops-resell.com and cc procurement@cloudops-parent.com per your note. For the first month we will pro-rate as requested; please confirm any billing contact updates to billing@cloudops-resell.com.

Tessa — can you schedule the 30-min onboarding window with Amy (and Marcus if helpful) for tomorrow afternoon? Karthik — please prep the SKU list for the variant in the HubSpot deal so we can include it in the acceptance payload.

Thanks everyone — will update once AWS confirms acceptance.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Head of Partner Ops, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Reseller_RevShare_Schedule.xlsx]
